description: This file defines an abstract generic service implementation class for managing entities, including CRUD operations and utility methods, within a SalesManager-based application.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
classes.description: A generic abstract class implementing core CRUD operations for entities, parameterized with entity and key types, utilizing a DAO for data access.

methods.name: getObjectClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this service.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity of specified class by its identifier.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches an entity by its primary key.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity where a specified field has a given value.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the entity, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: createEntity
methods.description: Internal method to handle creation logic, invoked by create().

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing entity, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: Returns a list of entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of entities.
